title: A severed instruction supplies memory only with real locality
statement: A retained key is intended to complete a nickase-recognition duplex and detach a clip carrying both the current selector and the next-selector blocker. The missing clip supplies physical progress memory. Nb.BbvCI availability does not qualify cleavage of this branched substrate. A reusable key could advance neighboring chains, and a complementary blocker could itself form an enzyme substrate. Trapping the key on detached waste until quenching is a proposed kinetic operation, not established single-use control.
